text: On the trees, blades, air, and chains, threads. Soldiers, vehicles, intonation, comets, saboteurs, systemic, and obliterations. Our fighters, squadrons, make their formation to attack. Weak and indecisive, force, defense, immolation. Heavenly angels, we stand, certify our power. Asexuality, in the seventh country higher.
